system.description:
7th Level Clan Feature

Your close affinity with the seas, oceans and lakes grant you and instinctual knowledge about the seas that others would spend lifetimes trying to match. While observing a body of water you can predict the weather, tides and visibility while traversing this water by making a Nature check vs a DC 5.

Additionally, while you are swimming, allies within 20 feet of you that attempt to follow you, can spend their Actions on their turns to swim behind you, following your swim trail, always ending keeping up with you and never being lost no matter how murky or dark the water is.

Finally, by spending 10 minutes submerged in a body of water, you can remove 1 rank of exhaustion as the waves gentle wash away your fatigue. You can do this once per rest.
